RecurringInvoiceProfile.title: Recurring Invoice Profile
RecurringInvoiceProfile.description: A recurring (periodic) billing definition — the template Shillinq uses to generate ordinary ARInvoice records on a schedule. The customer is a Nextcloud addressbook contact (customerReference), never an invented party schema. Generation produces standard ARInvoice records carrying recurringProfileId + billingPeriod provenance; there is no parallel invoice type. Numbering, per-line BTW and Peppol delivery are owned by bookkeeping-quote-order-invoice (CHAINED); SEPA collection is owned by bookkeeping-sepa-direct-debit (CHAINED).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create/update/delete of a RecurringInvoiceProfile is logged to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail.

customerReference.description: FK to the customer: a Nextcloud addressbook contact reference (UID/URI). A customer is a Nextcloud contact entity, not a bespoke schema (fleet convention). The financial CustomerMaster is resolved per AR conventions for terms/limits; no party schema is invented here.
customerReference.title: Customer Reference

lines.description: Embedded recurring line items. Period tokens ({period}/{month}/{year}) in description are expanded at generation, localized to the customer document language.

unitPrice.description: Unit price in the document currency (ex VAT).
unitPrice.title: Unit Price

revenueAccount.description: FK to the revenue GL Account (chart of accounts).
revenueAccount.title: Revenue Account

costCenter.description: FK to a cost center / dimension (bookkeeping-cost-centers-dimensions).
costCenter.title: Cost Center

lines.title: Lines

interval.description: Cadence multiplier — frequency=monthly, interval=2 means every 2 months.
interval.title: Interval

startDate.description: First billing period start (civil date, administration timezone).
startDate.title: Start Date

endCondition.description: Termination rule: { endDate } or { occurrenceCount }; absent = open-ended.

endDate.title: End Date
endDate.description: The date on which this record expires or ends.

occurrenceCount.title: Occurrence Count
occurrenceCount.description: Total number of invoices this profile generates before it ends. Counted from the first generated period; when it is reached the profile transitions to ended.

endCondition.title: End Condition

invoiceDay.description: Day of the period on which to invoice (1-31). Clamped to month length.
invoiceDay.title: Invoice Day

nextRunDate.description: Computed: the next civil date a generation run is due.
nextRunDate.title: Next Run Date

lastBillingPeriod.description: The most recently generated billing period key (YYYY-MM or YYYY-Www). Drives nextRunDate and idempotency.
lastBillingPeriod.title: Last Billing Period

remainingOccurrences.description: When endCondition.occurrenceCount is set, the count still to generate. Decremented per generated period.
remainingOccurrences.title: Remaining Occurrences

issueMode.description: draft-for-review (default) creates drafts; auto-issue issues immediately and catches up at most one missed period.
issueMode.title: Issue Mode

deliveryChannel.description: Delivery channel for issued invoices. peppol selectable only once bookkeeping-quote-order-invoice lands (CHAINED).
deliveryChannel.title: Delivery Channel

paymentTermsDays.description: Due-date offset (days) applied to generated invoices.
paymentTermsDays.title: Payment Terms Days

indexationPercent.description: Annual price indexation percentage applied once per startDate anniversary.
indexationPercent.title: Indexation Percent

indexationHistory.description: Applied indexations (date, percent, per-line old->new). Never retroactive; idempotent per anniversary year.

lineDeltas.title: Line Deltas
lineDeltas.description: A list of line deltas entries.

indexationHistory.title: Indexation History

sepaCollection.description: Route generated invoices into the SEPA direct-debit batch flow (CHAINED: bookkeeping-sepa-direct-debit). No DD logic in this change.
sepaCollection.title: SEPA Collection

contractReference.description: Soft FK to a Contract (contract-lifecycle-management) backing this billing.
contractReference.title: Contract Reference

lastRunStatus.description: Outcome of the last generation run; a field-change to failed triggers a notification.
lastRunStatus.title: Last Run Status

lastRunError.description: Human-readable reason when lastRunStatus = failed (no sensitive payloads).
lastRunError.title: Last Run Error

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Defined but not generating. Being completed/validated.

active.label: Active
active.description: Generating on schedule. nextRunDate is honoured by the scheduled workflow.

paused.label: Paused
paused.description: Generation frozen. nextRunDate is not advanced while paused; resume recomputes forward and lists skipped periods.

ended.label: Ended
ended.description: Terminal. Reached endDate / occurrenceCount, or ended manually.

activate.label: Activate
activate.description: Begin generating. Requires at least one line and a valid customer; auto-issue profiles additionally require the next-invoice preview to have been rendered and acknowledged.

guard.description: Profile must be complete before it can generate.

conditions.message: A recurring profile needs at least one line item.
A recurring profile needs a customer.

resume.label: Resume
resume.description: Resume generation; recompute nextRunDate forward and surface skipped periods.

endFromActive.label: End
endFromActive.description: Terminate the profile (manual, endDate reached, or occurrenceCount exhausted).

perPeriodNetAmount.description: Net (ex-VAT) total of all lines for one period: sum(quantity * unitPrice).

nextRunDate.description: The next civil date a generation run is due, derived from frequency * interval, invoiceDay (clamped to month length) and the last generated billing period. Feb-29 anniversaries fall to Feb-28 in non-leap years; arithmetic is on civil dates in the administration timezone, never UTC.

isDue.description: True when the profile is active and its nextRunDate is today or in the past.

isEndingSoon.description: True when an active profile is within 30 days of its endCondition.endDate, or has 1 occurrence left of an endCondition.occurrenceCount run. An open-ended profile (no endCondition) and an already-ended profile both resolve false. Materialised so the onProfileEndingSoon scheduled notification can filter on it.

shillinq-recurring-invoice-generation.name: Recurring invoice generation
shillinq-recurring-invoice-generation.description: Evaluated at least daily by OpenRegister's scheduled machinery. Selects RecurringInvoiceProfile records with status=active AND nextRunDate<=today and asks the RecurringInvoiceGenerator to generate the due period's ordinary ARInvoice. No app-local TimedJob/cron and no invalid IRegistrationContext:registerJob registration; generation is idempotent on the (profile, billingPeriod) key.

onDraftGenerated.description: A recurring draft invoice was generated and is awaiting review.

onProfileEndingSoon.description: A recurring profile is approaching its end condition. The scheduled trigger re-checks daily and matches on the materialised isEndingSoon calculation, so an open-ended or already-ended profile never fires.
